limitations: Automated checks and authored clinical review are not independent clinician certification.
PDF text and bounds validated; all pages also rasterized for contact-sheet review. No scanned/OCR challenge variants are included.
No fully synthetic specialty ultrasound, delivery or postpartum source located. Explicit source limitations remain.
External source verification records downloads and hashes at research time; later URL availability may change.
No real patient records are used. Coincidental name overlap with real people cannot be excluded.
